author: Ash

copy.intro: You want a band tee or a ridiculous birthday gift, and the nearest Spencer's is two malls away. Spencer's is known for graphic tees and gag gifts, and these stores cover the same ground. Pop-culture chains come first, then a novelty shop and the smaller labels for funny and gothic tees. Every one sells graphic tees, so a tee price sits next to each pick.

bodies.hot-topic:
Hot Topic is the closest thing to another Spencer's: a mall chain built on licensed pop culture, music and anime tees. Prices start at the InuYasha Yellow & White T-Shirt ($12.99) and top out with the WWE John Cena Wrestlemania 23 Garment-Dyed T-Shirt ($50.90).

Band tees like the Misfits Crimson Ghost Heavyweight T-Shirt ($39.90) sit in between. Sizes run XS to 5XL, with tall sizes too, and BoxLunch is the only other pick here with a tall range. Free shipping starts at $75. Pre-order merch sent to your home costs $1.99 more per item, so ship those to a store and the surcharge goes away.

It's mostly clothes and fandom merch, though. For the gag-gift side of a Spencer's trip, Archie McPhee is the better stop.
bodies.boxlunch:
BoxLunch is the gift-shop take on the same fandoms, with a charity hook built in. For every $10 you spend, it helps provide a meal through Feeding America, so a birthday present does a bit of extra work.

Tees start at $20.90, with Disney birthday tees like the Lilo & Stitch Angel Birthday T-Shirt, and nearly all of them stay under $40. The Wicked: For Good Glinda & Elphaba Icons Garment-Dyed T-Shirt ($36.90) is near the top. Sizes go XS to 5XL, plus Big & Tall up to 4XL.

Shipping and returns work like Hot Topic's: free shipping over $75, 30 days to return, and $1.99 extra on each pre-order item. If band tees are the goal rather than Disney and anime, start with Hot Topic's Misfits and Bad Bunny tees instead.
bodies.fye:
FYE is the budget pick for pop-culture tees, with every regular-price tee between $19.99 and $29.99. It's an entertainment chain with stores around the US, so the tees sit next to Funko Pop! figures, Pokémon cards, music and movies.

Start with its licensed tees, like the Back To The Future Racing T-Shirt ($19.99) or the Solo Leveling Jinwoo T-Shirt ($19.99). It also stocks Riot Society, whose Scarface The World is Yours T-Shirt is $26.99.

The catch is sizes and shipping. Tees stop at 2X, and standard shipping is $4.25 plus $3.75 per pound, so even one tee pays postage. Orders ship only to US addresses and a few territories. If you need bigger sizes, Hot Topic and BoxLunch both go to 5XL.
bodies.archie-mcphee:
Archie McPhee is the pick for the gag-gift half of Spencer's. It's a novelty shop that set up in Seattle in 1983, and it sells funny gifts and toys, from Bigfoot to rubber chickens.

The tee range is small, and that's worth knowing before you go. It makes its own, like the Rubber Chicken Museum T-Shirt and the Retro Bigfoot T-Shirt, and every one is $19.95 in S to XXL. So come for the gift and add a tee, not the other way round.

Free shipping starts at $50, the lowest threshold here, but it doesn't ship outside the US. New, unopened items can go back within 30 days. If a big wall of funny tees is what you're after, The Chivery has far more.
bodies.killstar:
Killstar is where to go for the gothic, occult side of Spencer's horror tees, and you'll pay more for it. Its tees run $50 to $60: the Blind Mind tee is $50 and its boxy T-shirts are $60, all in 100% cotton jersey.

The label calls its style total trash occult couture, so expect occult and horror graphics rather than jokes. Sizes run XS to 4XL. The US store ships free once you pass $175, which is three tees or more, and returns get 14 days, the shortest window on this list.

If the price is the problem, Hot Topic's tees top out about where Killstar's start. For black cats and Poe quotes at half the price, ModCloth's tees start at $25.
bodies.the-chivery:
The Chivery is the store for Spencer's-style funny tees. It's the official shop of theCHIVE. Most of its tees cost $28, like the Keep Calm and Chive On Tee and The KCCO Tee.

The useful thing to know is that most shirts are made to order. Allow 7 to 10 business days before anything ships, so it's not the place for a gift you need by the weekend. Sizes run Small to 3XL on nearly every tee, and some go to 5XL.

Free shipping needs $125, and only within the contiguous US. Its William Murray Golf tees, like Scuba Steve, are the priciest at $38. If you want a tee for under $28, FYE's start at $19.99.
bodies.modcloth:
ModCloth is the pick if you like Spencer's spooky tees but want a vintage-style take. It's a clothing store, and its graphic tees come from small labels like Witchwood Bags and Self-Care Shirts. A Dream Within A Dream Poe Quote: T-Shirt and the Black Cats T-Shirt are both $25.

Graphic tees run $25 to $37, and the $25 ones go from XS to 4XL. That matches Killstar's range at half the price, and it's far wider than AKIRA's. Free shipping needs $150, though. Returns get 30 days, with a $14 fee unless you bought its Checkout+ option.

There are no gag gifts here. Pair it with Archie McPhee if the trip was really about presents.
bodies.akira:
AKIRA is for the snarky slogan tees Spencer's does, in a going-out wardrobe. It's a Chicago label with stores in over 18 states, mostly selling its own dresses, shoes and coats. Its graphic tees lean on jokes: the Your Future Stepmom Graphic Tee ($29.90) and the Dump Him Tee ($39.90).

Tees run $29.90 to $79.90, and the top end is embellished, like the First Row Interstellar Rhinestone Tee. Graphic tees come in S to 1X only, the narrowest run here, even though its clothing goes to 3X.

US shipping is free from $75, but sale items don't count toward it. Returns get 30 days, with a $10 fee if you use its prepaid label. For bigger sizes in a joke tee, The Chivery goes to 5XL.

closing.heading: How to choose
closing.body: Start with what the trip was for. For fandom and band tees, Hot Topic starts lowest, at $12.99, and goes to 5XL, and BoxLunch covers the same fandoms with a meal donated for every $10. On a tight budget, FYE keeps every tee under $30, and Archie McPhee's are $19.95 if a gag gift is the real errand. For a joke on a shirt, The Chivery has the deepest range, as long as you can wait for made-to-order. Goth shoppers should look at Killstar, or ModCloth to spend half as much. AKIRA suits a slogan tee for a night out, in sizes up to 1X.

faqs.a: Its parent company has announced a deal to. Spencer Spirit Holdings agreed to buy Hot Topic from Sycamore Partners, pending regulatory approval, and Hot Topic is set to keep running as its own company under its own name.

Graphic tees are its main clothing line, from music and horror tees to funny and plus-size ones. It also sells backpacks, body jewelry, novelty and gag gifts, room decor, Halloween costumes and adult products.

faqs.q: How many Spencer's stores are there?
faqs.a: Over 630 across the United States and Canada. Most are in malls, and it's now opening in outlet centers too.
